description:
The image presents three pie charts, each representing the distribution of different categories related to reasoning-driven text-to-image generation. 
The first chart, "Categorical", is divided into four slices, representing "Existential Quantifiers" (green, 15.12%), "Limiter" (pink, 27.91%), "Negation" (orange, 27.91%), and "Universal Quantifiers" (blue, 29.07%). 
The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation", has three slices, representing "Absolute Absence" (purple, 18.71%), "Comparative Relationships" (blue, 36.26%), and "Approximate Quantities" (yellow, 45.03%). 
The third chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive", is divided into two slices, representing "Disjunctive" (light blue, 49.51%) and "Conjunctive" (pink, 50.49%). 
All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the categories are distinguishable by color; there is no legend or visually emphasized slices. The segments in each chart are ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
